verdicts.reason: Both candidates have the same structure and the same fatal flaws. The white quote has been pulled off its red panel and placed on the light grey background, where it is almost invisible. The red/white frame is left as an empty decorative box in the middle, and the attribution is tiny white italic on grey, so it is unreadable too. The skyline is a small detached strip on the right instead of the base of the composition. B's skyline is a little larger and its panel a little narrower, but neither change fixes the contrast or the hierarchy, so the two are equivalent.
